_readme: Ratchet for scripts/ci/assert-rls-floor.mjs (rls-floor-guard); format and rules in scripts/ci/rls-lists.mjs. Entries may only be removed, never added or widened (checked against the base commit). tables = check a, one allowance per missing flag (rlsOff, forceOff): a newly missing flag fails, and a repaired listed flag fails as stale until it is removed. policies = check c findings with a tracked fix; referenceData = reviewed public catalogs. Both name one exact constant-true SELECT policy (table, policy, cmd, roles); a constant-true INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/ALL policy is never exempt.
